name: CA-08
label: Safe D

key_factors: Incumbent Garamendi running with large cash advantage
model.rationale: Garamendi holds a D+19 district with over $1.1 million on hand against a challenger who raised under $9,000, and prediction markets price his reelection near certainty. With no polls or expert ratings suggesting movement, the fundamentals strongly favor the incumbent.
model.watch: A surprise late outside-spending blitz for Recile is the only realistic path to narrowing this race.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
John Garamendi seeks another term in a northern California district that leans Democratic by about nineteen points. He enters the general election with a large financial edge, roughly $1.2 million on hand, while Republican Rudy Recile has raised less than nine thousand dollars and has no outside support on record. No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, but prediction markets give Garamendi about a 96 percent chance of winning.

The combination of a favorable partisan baseline, incumbency, and a lopsided money gap makes this one of the safer Democratic holds on the House map. The main uncertainty is simply the absence of polling, which widens the error band without changing the expected outcome.
